item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find public 2024 evidence that Tinubu voluntarily published his own asset declaration, campaign-finance records, or a conflict-of-interest register. The record instead shows civil-society pressure for disclosure, continued cybercrime-based pressure on journalists, and only selective, reactive investigations when public outrage became unavoidable.","evidence":[{"title":"President Tinubu directs reorganisation of the Bureau of Public Procurement","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-06-15","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-directs-reorganisation-of-the-bureau-of-public-procurement/","summary":"Tinubu ordered the BPP reorganized for greater efficiency and transparency.
